items.summary: Run fp32 element-read linear-texture probe on gfx1100 (Linux) and gfx1201 (Windows): build+run projects/TIGRE/probe/tex_filter_probe.cpp, record verdict (REJECTED/LINEAR/POINT) in probe/README.md table. Baseline gfx90a=REJECTED. Lets us scope the TIGRE PR texture claim and PORTING_GUIDE arch-scope precisely.

When moat-port syncs CERN/TIGRE#809 (multi-GPU TV halo exchange overlap), the fork's cuda_to_hip.h needs seven new mappings the PR's commits use: cudaEventCreateWithFlags, cudaEventDisableTiming, cudaStreamWaitEvent, cudaDeviceCanAccessPeer, cudaDeviceEnablePeerAccess, cudaErrorPeerAccessAlreadyEnabled, cudaMemcpyPeerAsync (to their hip* names). The MI355X/gfx942 validation of #809 added them only in never-pushed scratch branches, so without them the HIP build of the synced fork fails to compile. Nothing to do until #809 merges upstream and a sync round starts.
